sections.theory:
Oral Communication

The teacher should divide students into various groups wherein they will discuss their daily responsibilities in home. Teacher should guide them in their course of discussion.

Vocabulary and Grammar

A. Fill in the blanks with suitable abstract nouns. The adjectives, verbs or nouns given in the brackets should offer clues.

1. He is a man of ........ (strong)

2. The people in this part of the country live in ........ (poor).

3. ........ to animals is a punishable offence. (cruel)

4. He is on a ........ to Mecca. (pilgrim)

5. I have great ........ to welcome you. (please).

6. ........ is the best period of one's life. (child)

7. ........ should always be avoided. (waste).

8. As a parent my children's ........ is of utmost importance to me. (safe).

9. As the sun went below the horizon ........ enveloped the planet. (dark).

10. There is no end to his ........ (wicked)

B. Fill in the blanks with the appropriate form of the word given in the brackets.

1. My friend did not ........ to my letter. (response)

2. He behaved ........ (strange)

3. Teacher's ........ had great effect on students. (exhort)

4. He ........ his point with valid arguments. (substance)

5. Greedy people will never get any ........ in life. (satisfy)

6. I don't think that there is any ........ for you to come again. (necessary)

7. Though his early attempts were not ........ he did not lose heart. (success)

8. I have ........ that song. (memory)

9. The teacher ........ her to go home early. (permission)

11. Hubble made many astronomical ........ (discover)

C. Complete the following sentences using conditional sentences type three. Change the form of verb if required.

1. If you ____ asked me,I ____ told you the truth.

2. We ____ got lost if we ____ a map.

3. If you ____ had a daughter, I ____ called her chubby doll?

4. If the shops ____ been open, they ____ bought something.

5. If Ambreen ____ known that,she ____ come back early.

6. We ____ sung a song if somebody ____ played the hormonica.

7. If I ____ (live )in Spain,I ____ (learn )Spanish.

8. If it ____ (rain) yesterday,we ____ ( stay) at home.

9. I ____ ( go) if Amer ____ (invite) me.

10. If my son ____ (study) medicine he ____ (become) a doct

11. If you ____ (come) early you ____ ( see ) a comet.

12. What Mary ____ ( do ) if she ____ ( be) late for school?
